project.security.title: Security consultant
project.security.description: Mobile app that ensures the compliance and integrity of security equipment at Itaú branches.
project.security.full1: Within the Salesforce environment, I developed Security Consultant, a mobile app to ensure the compliance and integrity of security equipment in Itaú branches.
project.security.full2: I needed to create a simple and reliable mobile experience for security teams to validate equipment and record inspection data.
project.security.full3: I built six mobile screens with LWC and two REST APIs in Apex, learning both technologies from scratch. These APIs were later reused to export Salesforce data for dashboards.
project.security.full4: The final solution improved inspection accuracy and streamlined security checks, while also strengthening my skills in LWC and Apex.
project.zera.title: BeatGoals
project.zera.description: Complete Fullstack app with database, secure authentication, and ChatGPT-powered AI integration.
project.zera.full1: In my postgraduate course, I developed BeatGoals, a full-stack app to help users set goals and track progress with an engaging experience.
project.zera.full2: My objective was to let users create goals, break them into mini-goals, and experience a gamified journey. I also wanted to integrate AI to help users define clearer, more effective goals.
project.zera.full3: I built the backend with Node.js, used MongoDB for the database, and designed the interface with Tailwind CSS. I also added gamification features and integrated ChatGPT for smart goal suggestions.
project.zera.full4: The final product is a motivating, AI-enhanced tool that simplifies goal achievement while improving my skills in Tailwind, MongoDB, and Node.js.
project.portal.title: SIN Portal
project.portal.description: New cash-in-transit (CIT) platform, accelerated transaction processing times, and enhanced user experience.
project.portal.full1: I worked on SIN Portal, a new cash-in-transit (CIT) platform created to replace an outdated system and support the bank’s modernization goals.
project.portal.full2: My task was to help deliver a faster and more intuitive experience for users while ensuring the platform could efficiently process CIT transactions.
project.portal.full3: I developed three Angular screens and supported the API integration with third-party companies that would use the new platform, improving my soft skills while coordinating with external teams.
project.portal.full4: The new solution accelerated transaction processing, improved usability, and strengthened my abilities in Angular, API integration, and cross-team communication.
project.port.title: Portfolio
project.port.description: SPA Portfolio built with modern technologies to deliver an aesthetic, animated, and smooth experience.
project.port.full1: I developed my Portfolio, a modern single-page application designed to present my work with a clean, aesthetic, and highly interactive experience.
project.port.full2: The goal was to rebuild my outdated portfolio and create a smooth, animated interface that highlights my recent projects in a professional and visually engaging way.
project.port.full3: I built the application using React, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP, focusing on modern UI patterns, animations, and best practices to strengthen my front-end development skills.
project.port.full4: The final result provides a fast and dynamic browsing experience while showcasing my latest work and solidifying my ability to build contemporary, animation-rich web interfaces.
project.net.title: Netflix Clone
project.net.description: An application built to replicate the Netflix website, essential for learning user experience concepts.
project.net.full1: I worked on a Netflix Clone, a web application created to replicate the Netflix interface and improve my understanding of user experience and modern frontend development.
project.net.full2: The goal was to build a clean and functional layout while practicing key concepts in React and exploring how streaming platforms organize and display content.
project.net.full3: Using React, JavaScript, I followed Bonieky Lacerda’s tutorial while making small adjustments throughout the project. The interface uses data from the themoviedb.org API, and all image rights belong to Netflix.
project.net.full4: Although the project was built for study purposes, it strengthened my React skills and helped me better understand component structure, API consumption, and UI replication.
project.poke.title: Pokedex
project.poke.description: App developed to interact with public APIs, focusing on structuring API requests and interpreting responses effectively.
project.poke.full1: I developed Pokedex, a web application built to interact with public Pokémon APIs and display structured information in a simple and intuitive interface.
project.poke.full2: The goal was to practice API consumption by sending requests to a public REST API, handling responses, and organizing the returned data clearly for users.
project.poke.full3: I built the interface using Angular and Bootstrap, learning how to structure services, manage state, and consume external APIs effectively throughout the project.
project.poke.full4: This project strengthened my understanding of HTTP requests, asynchronous operations, and API-driven development, helping solidify my Angular fundamentals.
project.tft.title: TFT Store
project.tft.description: React project based on a real game, using solid programming logic, state management, and array manipulation.
project.tft.full1: I developed TFT Store, a React single-page application inspired by a real game, designed as a visual shop where users can buy champions with varying rarities.
project.tft.full2: The goal was to create an interactive interface that simulates champion appearance rates, where higher player levels increase the chances of finding rare champions.
project.tft.full3: I built the project using React, JavaScript, and CSS, focusing on state management, probability calculations, and array manipulation to generate champion rolls based on level-based odds.
project.tft.full4: The final application strengthened my skills in React and applied logic, particularly in handling randomness through mathematical rules and managing interactive state updates.
project.impacta.title: Impact +
project.impacta.description: A social platform that connects people needing blood donations with those who can help, plus support for other social causes.
project.impacta.full1: I developed Impact+, a social platform that connects people who need blood donations with volunteers willing to help, also supporting other social causes.
project.impacta.full2: My goal was to build a full-stack solution using Angular, Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL as part of the final project for my Generation Brasil bootcamp.
project.impacta.full3: Working in a group of four, I contributed to both backend and frontend development, making this the most important Java-based project of my early career.
project.impacta.full4: The platform strengthened my practical skills in Java, Angular, and Spring Boot, and the project’s success directly contributed to my hiring at Itaú after the program.
project.move.title: Move.It
project.move.description: Fullstack project that applies the Pomodoro technique to boost productivity through a gamified task system.
project.move.full1: I worked on Move It, a fullstack application that applies the Pomodoro technique to improve productivity through a gamified task system.
project.move.full2: The goal was to explore how timed focus cycles and short exercise breaks can encourage healthier habits for people who spend long hours on the computer.
project.move.full3: Using React, TypeScript, and Node.js, I followed the original codebase developed by a Rocketseat instructor during an online event, making only small adjustments while learning the project’s structure and concepts.
project.move.full4: Even though the application was not created by me, working through its code helped me understand fullstack workflows, Pomodoro-based logic, and the use of gamification to enhance user engagement.
project.hero.title: Be The Hero
project.hero.description: A platform where NGOs can publish specific cases requiring financial support, and users can donate directly to the causes they connect with.
project.hero.full1: I worked on Be The Hero, a fullstack application designed to connect NGOs seeking financial help with users willing to support meaningful causes.
project.hero.full2: The goal was to provide a simple platform where organizations could register specific cases and donors could contribute directly to the ones they identified with.
project.hero.full3: Using React, JavaScript, and Node.js, I followed the codebase originally developed by a Rocketseat instructor during a one-week event, applying small adjustments while learning the project’s structure.
project.hero.full4: Although I did not build the app from scratch, working through its implementation helped me understand fullstack flows and how to structure donation-driven platforms that connect users and NGOs.
